geometry.source_dimensions: Cross-source recipe: Haj-Ali 2009 pitch and parametric glue zones; Popil 2017 separate sheet calipers and board caliper; coupon length/width numerical choices
geometry.initial_condition: assembled conditioned geometry with zero stress; corrugation forming, curing and moisture history are not simulated
geometry.equation: sinusoidal centerline with constant-normal-thickness sampled strip
geometry.contact_tie_assumption: finite solid glue bridges; conforming bonded interfaces; no interface separation or cure law

materials.frame_source: analytic local flute tangent; local x=tangent, y=width, z=in-plane normal

tooling.mode: rounded capsule on finite backing box
tooling.barrier_scale_role: numerical conditioning sensitivity on prescribed punch only; not a material calibration; activation distance and collision floors unchanged
tooling.timing: prescribed end pose and consistent step velocity in preDynamics and postCommit; independent end gap audit

solver.backend: implicit nonlinear Matter FEM on Apple Metal
solver.release_policy: right grip free; left grip remains fixed; physical state preserved

paper_projection_residual_scaling.scope: left-scales the exact 13 implicit Hill state residuals only; no energy, yield, history, or global tolerance change

paper_hill_accurate_projection.scope: opt-in tighter local implicit-state projection tolerance for source-ordered 13-state Hill materials only; requires compensated arithmetic; global solver tolerances and constitutive equations unchanged

corrugator_starch_interface.activation_step_role: after an accepted zero-displacement reference step; activation request is transactional and consumes no scoring stroke

retained_matrix_damage_overlay.parameter_contract: all values are explicit source-bound feasible-set inputs; no default or corrugated-grade calibration is inferred

status_diagnostics_semantics: CSV retains NMMatterStatusGPU.diagnostics x/y/z/w verbatim. Successful finalization writes minimum J, maximum stress, scheduler numerical.y, and maximum contact speed; scheduler numerical.y is not populated as a successful KKT residual in this probe path and may remain zero. Failure statuses replace the vector with the originating failure-site float4 payload (for example, code 10 uses relative residual, relative correction, volume residual, and pressure residual). Independent min_J and max_J are recomputed from accepted native FEM kinematics (stored displacement for opted-in elements, positions for legacy); status_diagnostic_z must not be interpreted as the successful-state KKT residual.
evidence_boundary: native software mechanics instrument only; analytic geometry approximation and published material inputs do not establish physical validation
